answer_1.quote: We finetune small 7-8B vision-language models to reason with vision specialists and evaluate our models on 6 benchmarks covering both perception and reasoning skills.

answer_2.quote: We adapt VLMEvalKit for our evaluation, where an LLM judge (i.e. GPT-4-turbo) is used to score predictions between 0 and 1 compared to the groundtruth short answers for open-ended questions.
